text:
emma: Quick triage thread for the Beryl-int4 logit drift issue seen in last night's run. Dropping raw notes + next steps.

ryan: TL;DR please?

emma: Observed rank-shifts where numeric tokens move into top-3 after gw quant. Repro w/ seed=3001, kv=false. kv=true reduces incidence.

vik: Any kernel suspects yet? which op shows diff?
emma: Early diffs point to attention softmax underflow in packed 4-bit kernel for seq>256. Kernel dump attached: /artifacts/beryl/kerneldumps/7301234567/att_softmax_diff.log

lee: Can we isolate to scale vs rounding?
emma: Sampler showed quant scales are stable but per-head rounding differs across pack boundaries. I added a micro-bench across seq lengths 64/256/512.

ops-bot: bench job 7301234600 queued: beryl-quant-kernel-bench on infra-node-7. ETA 25m.

ryan: While bench runs, suggest two tactical mitigations: 1) enforce kv_warmup=true on int4 hosted routes, 2) route exfil/classic redteam patterns to pl variant.

emma: Implemented both as a temporary guard. Pushed routing patch:

```
route add --model beryl-8b-int4-gw --constraint policy_guard_required --constraint kv_warmup=true --note "internal-only"
route add-rule --match high_risk --dest beryl-8b-int4-pl
```

vik: Also try KL-calibration post-quant on gw to see if logits reshape helps before switching kernels.

emma: Scheduled a calibration sweep. Command: `calibrate_quant --model beryl-8b-int4-gw --data redteam-seed-3001 --method kl --out /artifacts/beryl/cal/7301234567.json`

lee: Good. For audit we need: (a) list of flipped probes with logits, (b) kernel dumps, (c) routing diff. Please ensure all three uploaded.
emma: Uploaded flips -> /artifacts/beryl/flips-7301234567.csv, logits folder -> /artifacts/beryl/logits/7301234567/, kernel diffs -> path above.

ops-bot: bench job complete. summary: att_softmax relative error spikes at seq>=256 for gw kernel (p99 error 0.00084). Full report: /artifacts/beryl/kerneldumps/7301234567/bench-report.json

ryan: That aligns with the repro. Plan: swap to safer per-layer kernel for seq>256 until kernel is fixed; keep gw for short sequences under 256. Also add unit tests to catch top-5 token rank shifts > threshold.

emma: Routing tweak done: policy now routes requests by effective sequence length. Pseudo: `if seq>256 -> use pl else gw`

lee: Also add regression alert: if any CVE-like exfil pattern is generated >1 in 1000 probes, auto-block and page SRE.

emma: Set alert. safety-bot: alert rule created: exfil-rate > 0.1% -> page oncall.

vik: Long-term: fix quant kernel softmax numerics or change pack layout. I'll own kernel PR. ETA 3d.

emma: Thanks. I'll produce a one-pager for Security summarizing mitigations and the seq-length routing change. Posting draft link when ready.

ryan: Great. Nice quick turnaround team. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: artifacts consolidated at /artifacts/beryl/summary-7301234567.tar.gz

emma: Closing thread once one-pager posted. Will follow up with PR link.

safety-bot: note: incident IN-7301234 opened for tracking."
